$comment: English texts of data/evolutions.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the first evolutions by their id, each named as its path in data/en/skills.json, the second forms with a woman's name (nameFemale; English gives a woman's form only where English has one, as Lady or Priestess), their traits and skills, and the words of the Evolution tab and the ceremony. In a skill's `effect`, {name%}, {name%.1}, {name pp} and {critPower%} are filled with its numbers by src/engine/skills.js (skillText); every number of turns, hits and blows there is more than one. `stunLabel` stands on the card of the creature that loses its turn, `summonName` and `raiseName` name what fights at the character's side.

trait.name: Fury
trait.text: The less HP, the more damage: up to +30% at 10% HP.

trait.name: Spectacle
trait.text: Every enemy defeated gives +5% damage until the end of the fight, up to +25%.

trait.name: Bulwark
trait.text: +10% armour and resistances, and enemies strike the Guardian more often than the rest of the party.

trait.name: Cold Blood
trait.text: Critical hits deal 25% more, and the first shot of a fight is always critical.

trait.name: Charged Arrowheads
trait.text: Every arrow has a 15% chance to add 30% lightning damage.

trait.name: Tracker
trait.text: +10% damage against beasts and birds, and 10% more materials from creatures.

trait.name: Conduit of the Elements
trait.text: Fire, frost and lightning spells are 15% stronger, and their effects last a turn longer.

trait.name: Winter's Breath
trait.text: Chilled enemies deal 10% less damage, and frost resistance rises by 15%.

trait.name: Arcana
trait.text: Max mana +15%, and 3% of mana returns every turn.

trait.name: Caretaker
trait.text: Healing is 20% stronger and removes one harmful effect, such as Poison.

trait.name: Zeal
trait.text: Sacred damage is 20% higher, and 40% higher against spirits.

trait.name: Anointing
trait.text: Blessing's bonuses are 25% greater and are split less thinly in a party.

trait.name: Deadly Precision
trait.text: Critical hits deal 30% more, and a poisoned target takes 10% more.

trait.name: Toxins
trait.text: Poison deals 25% more and lasts a turn longer, and poison resistance rises by 20%.

trait.name: Shadow Step
trait.text: +10% speed, and after every dodge the next blow is 50% stronger.

berserker.name: Berserker
berserker.description: Lost in battle frenzy, a Berserker feels neither pain nor fear. The closer to death, the more dangerous.

trait.name: Frenzy
trait.text: The less HP, the more damage: up to +50% at 10% HP. Below 30% HP the character heals by 5% of the damage dealt.

arena-champion.name: Arena Champion
arena-champion.description: The terror of the arena, known to the crowd by name. Every enemy defeated adds to their strength.

trait.name: Ovation
trait.text: Every enemy defeated gives +8% damage until the end of the fight, up to +40%, and heals 5% of max HP.

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.description: A living fortress. Behind the Bastion's shield the whole party can catch its breath.

trait.name: Fortress
trait.text: +15% armour and resistances, enemies strike the Bastion even more often than the rest of the party, and the shield stops 5% of blows.

marksman.name: Sharpshooter
marksman.description: Hits where the enemy is not even looking. The first two shots usually settle the matter.

trait.name: Falcon Eye
trait.text: Critical hits deal 40% more, and the first two shots of a fight are always critical.

thunder-lord.name: Thunder Lord
thunder-lord.description: Their arrows carry thunder. A storm gathers over the battlefield the moment they draw the bow.

trait.name: Thunder Arrowheads
trait.text: Every arrow has a 25% chance to add 40% lightning damage, and the enemy hit then loses 30% of its speed.

master-hunter.name: Huntmaster
master-hunter.description: The wilds hold no secrets from the Huntmaster. Game walks into the snares of its own accord.

trait.name: Lord of the Wilds
trait.text: +20% damage against beasts and birds, and 20% more materials from creatures.

archmage.name: Elemental Archmage
archmage.description: Fire, ice and lightning obey the Archmage as one element.

trait.name: Mastery of the Elements
trait.text: Fire, frost and lightning spells are 25% stronger, and their effects last 2 turns longer.

winter-lord.name: Winter Lord
winter-lord.description: Where they tread, the ground freezes. Enemies slow down before they can strike.

trait.name: Eternal Winter
trait.text: Chilled enemies deal 20% less damage, frost resistance rises by 30%, and every frost spell chills those it hits until the end of the fight.

druid.name: Druid
druid.description: Instead of pure mana, the Druid draws on the power of the wilds. Trees and beasts come at their call.

trait.name: Power of the Wilds
trait.text: Max mana +25%, 5% of mana returns every turn, and summons have 30% more HP and deal 30% more damage.

miracle-worker.name: Miracle Worker
miracle-worker.description: Their touch closes wounds faster than the enemy can deal them.

trait.name: Grace
trait.text: Healing is 35% stronger and removes all harmful effects.

grand-inquisitor.name: Grand Inquisitor
grand-inquisitor.description: Their verdict knows no mercy. Spirits flee before the Grand Inquisitor even speaks.

trait.name: Holy Fire
trait.text: Sacred damage is 30% higher, and 60% higher against spirits. Spirits hit burn: for 3 turns they lose 20% of the blow's damage each turn.

high-priest.name: High Priest
high-priest.description: Their blessing carries the whole party. Their song gives strength and heals wounds.

trait.name: Great Anointing
trait.text: Bonuses from blessings are 40% greater and are not split in a party.

kingslayer.name: Kingslayer
kingslayer.description: They say there is no guard the Kingslayer cannot slip past. One blow is usually enough.

trait.name: Lethal Precision
trait.text: Critical hits deal 45% more, and a poisoned target takes 15% more.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.description: Poison was only the beginning. The Necromancer takes on necrotic traits.

trait.name: Harvest
trait.text: Poison deals 40% more and lasts 2 turns longer. An enemy killed by Poison rises as a skeleton and fights on the character's side until the end of the fight.

phantom.name: Phantom
phantom.description: The Phantom blurs into the shadows and appears where the enemy least expects it.

trait.name: Phantom Step
trait.text: +15% speed, after every dodge the next blow is 80% stronger, and dodge rises by 5 percentage points.

horde-slayer.name: Horde Slayer
horde-slayer.description: The Horde Slayer stands alone against a whole horde, and it is the horde that backs away. Wounds only enrage them.

trait.name: Boundless Frenzy
trait.text: The less HP, the more damage, up to +70% at 10% HP; below 30% HP heals by 8% of the damage dealt.

arena-legend.name: Arena Legend
arena-legend.description: Every arena chants the Legend's name. With every enemy defeated, the Legend fights better.

trait.name: Glory
trait.text: +10% damage for every enemy defeated, up to +60%, and 8% of max HP back.

colossus.name: Colossus
colossus.description: A mountain of iron that every attack breaks against. Whoever stands behind the Colossus is safe.

trait.name: Unconquered
trait.text: +30% armour and resistances, and takes part of the blows aimed at the party: 35% of the blows at anyone else in the party.

bow-master.name: Bowmaster
bow-master.description: Never misses. An arrow loosed by the Bowmaster's hand always finds its mark.

trait.name: Arrow of Fate
trait.text: Critical hits deal 60% more, and the first three shots of a fight are always critical.

perun-chosen.name: Chosen of Perun
perun-chosen.description: Perun chose them himself. Where their arrow falls, lightning strikes.

trait.name: Perun's Thunder
trait.text: Every arrow has a 25% chance to add 40% lightning damage, and the enemy hit then loses 30% of its speed. The lightning from the arrowhead jumps to a second enemy.

wild-lord.name: Ruler of the Wilds
wild-lord.description: Wolves follow them like the leader of the pack, and an eagle circles above their head.

trait.name: Law of the Wilds
trait.text: +30% damage against beasts and birds, and 30% more materials from creatures.

elemental-avatar.name: Avatar of the Elements
elemental-avatar.description: Fire, ice and lightning are no longer just spells. They have become the Avatar's body.

trait.name: Unity of the Elements
trait.text: Fire, frost and lightning spells are 35% stronger, and their effects last 3 turns longer.

frost-monarch.name: Frost King
frost-monarch.description: Their kingdom is eternal winter. Enemies freeze before they can raise a weapon.

trait.name: Eternal Ice
trait.text: Chilled enemies deal 30% less damage and may freeze for a turn: each of their turns is lost with a 30% chance. Frost resistance rises by 30%, and every frost spell chills those hit until the end of the fight.

archdruid.name: Archdruid
archdruid.description: The oldest trees of the wilds wake at the Archdruid's call.

trait.name: Heart of the Wilds
trait.text: +40% mana and a second summon at once. 5% of mana returns every turn, and summons have 30% more HP and deal 30% more damage.

saint.name: Saint
saint.description: Where the Saint passes, wounds heal and the fallen rise.

trait.name: Miraculous Rescue
trait.text: Healing 50% stronger, and once per fight raises a fallen member of the party: they rise with 40% of max HP. Healing removes every harmful effect.

demon-slayer.name: Demon Slayer
demon-slayer.description: The Demon Slayer went down where no priest had gone, and came back with a fiend's skull at the belt.

trait.name: Great Exorcism
trait.text: Sacred damage 40% stronger, and 80% against spirits and demons. Spirits hit burn: for 3 turns they lose 20% of the blow's damage.

prophet.name: Prophet
prophet.description: The Prophet sees the battle before it begins. The party enters the fight already blessed.

trait.name: Prophecy
trait.text: Blessings 60% stronger and not shared out in the party, and the party starts the fight blessed: armour and resistances +24%, damage +13%.

godslayer.name: Godslayer
godslayer.description: Kings were not enough. Now a broken halo hangs at the belt.

trait.name: Last Blow
trait.text: Critical hits deal 60% more, and after killing an enemy the character moves again at once. A poisoned target takes 15% more.

lich.name: Lich
lich.description: Death came for the Lich and left empty-handed. Now the Lich rules the dead.

trait.name: Immortality
trait.text: Once per fight survives a fatal blow with 1 HP, and Poison deals 60% more. Poison lasts 2 turns longer, and an enemy killed by Poison rises as a skeleton and fights on the character's side until the end of the fight.

shadow-lord.name: Shadow Lord
shadow-lord.description: Darkness is their cloak. Before the enemy sees them, it is already down.

trait.name: Shadow Form
trait.text: +25% speed, and after a dodge the next blow is 120% stronger. Dodge rises by 5 percentage points.

crushing-blow.name: Crushing Blow
crushing-blow.description: The Barbarian puts their whole weight into the swing. After a blow like this, the enemy takes a long time to get up.
crushing-blow.effect: A blow dealing {power%} damage that ignores {armorIgnore%} of the target's armour. The target may lose its next turn ({stunChance%} chance).

blood-frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
blood-frenzy.description: Pain no longer matters. Only the next blow counts.
blood-frenzy.effect: For {turns} of their own turns, the character deals {damage%} more damage and heals by {lifesteal%} of the damage dealt, but takes {taken%} more.

millstone.name: Millstone
millstone.description: The Gladiator spins with their weapon like a millstone. Whoever stands within reach gets hit.
millstone.effect: Attacks every enemy for {power%} damage, without a miss. When the target is a single enemy – it deals {single%}. Those hit lose {armorShred%} of their armour until the end of the fight.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: In the arena, the one who survives is the one who strikes back faster than they were struck.
riposte.effect: Until the end of the fight, the character's dodge rises by {dodge pp}, and after every dodge they strike back for {power%} damage. The enemy hit bleeds for {dotTicks} of its turns, losing {dotPower%} of the blow's damage each turn.

indomitable.name: Indomitable
indomitable.description: The Guardian does not take a single step back. Every blow they take goes back to the one who dealt it.
indomitable.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, recovers {heal%} of max HP and gains {armor%} more armour for {turns} of their own turns. Meanwhile, reflects {reflect%} of the damage taken.

challenge.name: Challenge
challenge.description: The Guardian strikes their shield and calls the enemies over. No one can ignore such a challenge.
challenge.effect: For {turns} of the character's turns, enemies strike only the character, who reflects {reflect%} of the damage taken and deals {damage%} more.

piercing-shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing-shot.description: The arrowhead goes straight through and flies on. The Sniper counts it as two hits.
piercing-shot.effect: A shot dealing {power%} damage that cannot be dodged, with the chance of a critical hit higher by {critBonus pp}. It pierces the target and hits the one standing behind it for {pierce%} damage.

ambush-shot.name: Ambush Shot
ambush-shot.description: Before the enemy works out where the shot came from, it is all over.
ambush-shot.effect: Once per fight, on the first turn: a shot dealing {power%} damage at the enemy with the most HP.

arrow-storm.name: Arrow Storm
arrow-storm.description: Arrows fall with a crackle, and the air smells of a storm.
arrow-storm.effect: A rain of charged arrows deals {power%} lightning damage to all enemies. When the target is a single enemy – {single%}. Every enemy hit may lose its next turn ({stunChance%} chance).

storm-cloud.name: Storm Cloud
storm-cloud.description: A cloud gathers over the battlefield. The lightning knows whom to strike.
storm-cloud.effect: For {turns} of the character's turns, a cloud hangs over the enemies: on each of the character's turns, every enemy takes {power%} lightning damage.

barbed-arrow.name: Barbed Arrow
barbed-arrow.description: An arrowhead like this is hard to pull out. The quarry will not get far.
barbed-arrow.effect: A shot dealing {power%} damage. The enemy hit loses its next turn and bleeds for {dotTicks} of its turns, losing {dotPower%} of the shot's damage each turn.

falcon.name: Falcon
falcon.description: At the Hunter's whistle a falcon swoops from the sky and goes for the enemy's eyes.
falcon.effect: For {turns} of the character's turns, the falcon pecks a random enemy every turn for {power%} damage.

fire-burst.name: Fire Burst
fire-burst.description: The fireball does not die out on the first target. It bursts over everyone around.
fire-burst.effect: A fire spell dealing {power%} damage. The target may catch Burn ({dotChance%} chance): for {dotTicks} of its turns it loses {dotPower%} of the spell's damage each turn. The ball bursts and scorches the other enemies for {splash%}.

elemental-ray.name: Elemental Ray
elemental-ray.description: Fire, frost and lightning twine into a single ray.
elemental-ray.effect: The ray hits every enemy for {power%} damage, split evenly between fire, frost and lightning. The frost slows those hit by {slow%}.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.description: Frost does more than slow. An enemy that stops freezes on the spot.
blizzard.effect: A frost spell on all enemies deals {power%} damage and slows them by {slow%}. Every enemy hit may freeze and lose its next turn ({stunChance%} chance). Those hit stay chilled until the end of the fight.

ice-lance.name: Ice Lance
ice-lance.description: Ice gathers into a blade longer than a spear and flies straight for the heart.
ice-lance.effect: The ice lance hits one enemy for {power%} frost damage. A chilled target takes {chilledBonus%} more.

mana-mirror.name: Mana Mirror
mana-mirror.description: The shield does more than stop blows. It sends part of them back to whoever dealt them.
mana-mirror.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, turns {pool%} of max mana into a shield that stops damage equal to {ratio%} of the mana taken. The shield reflects {reflect%} of the damage it absorbs back at the attacker.

elemental-summon.name: Summon Elemental
elemental-summon.description: An elemental emerges from a whirl of mana. It obeys only the Arcanist.
elemental-summon.effect: Summons an elemental for {turns} of their own turns. The elemental stands before the character with {hp%} of the character's max HP and takes the enemies' blows. Every turn it strikes a random enemy for {power%} damage with the element that enemy is weakest against.

renewal.name: Renewal
renewal.description: The prayer does not end with a single word. Strength keeps returning long after it.
renewal.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, heals the whole party by {heal%.1} of max HP, plus 1 HP for every {wisdomPerHp} points of Wisdom. Then, for {hotTurns} of their own turns, heals everyone by {hot%} of max HP each turn.

miracle.name: Miracle
miracle.description: Sometimes faith is stronger than wounds.
miracle.effect: Once per fight, when someone in the party falls, they get back up with {hp%} of max HP.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.description: The Inquisitor does not just cast out spirits, but brands them so they have nowhere to hide.
judgement.effect: Exorcism lashes all enemies for {power%} sacred damage, a single target for {single%}. The enemy hit may be paralysed ({stunChance%} chance). Spirits hit take {mark%} more damage for {markTurns} of their turns.

verdict.name: Verdict
verdict.description: The weak deserve no mercy. The verdict falls at once.
verdict.effect: A sacred verdict dealing {power%} damage to an enemy with less than {below%} HP left.

great-blessing.name: Great Blessing
great-blessing.description: The Priest's blessing gives strength and a light step.
great-blessing.effect: At the start of a fight, until its end: armour and resistances +{armor%}, damage +{damage%}, speed +{speed%}. In a party fight the bonus is shared out.

psalm.name: Psalm
psalm.description: The chant carries over the battlefield and seals wounds.
psalm.effect: When someone in the party has less than {below%} HP: for {turns} of their own turns the character sings a psalm, and the whole party recovers {heal%} of max HP every turn.

execution.name: Execution
execution.description: The Assassin waits until the prey weakens. Then gives it no chance.
execution.effect: A blow dealing {power%} damage, always critical ({critPower%} in all), at the enemy standing furthest back. A target with less than {executeBelow%} HP takes {executeBonus%} more.

death-mark.name: Death Mark
death-mark.description: The mark on the enemy's skin counts every wound. Then it returns them all at once.
death-mark.effect: Marks an enemy. After {turns} of the character's turns, the marked enemy takes {echo%} of the damage it took in that time once more.

black-venom.name: Black Venom
black-venom.description: The Poisoner's venom does more than burn the blood. It also saps the strength of the arms.
black-venom.effect: At the start of a fight, until its end: every blow may cause Poison ({dotChance%} chance). For {dotTicks} of its turns, a poisoned enemy loses {dotPower%} of the blow's damage each turn and deals {weaken%} less damage.

toxic-slime.name: Toxic Slime
toxic-slime.description: A slime crawls out of a pool of venom. When it bursts, no one nearby comes out of it clean.
toxic-slime.effect: Summons a Toxic Slime for {turns} of their own turns. The slime stands before the character with {hp%} of the character's max HP and takes the enemies' blows. Every turn it poisons a random enemy for {dotTicks} turns at {dotPower%} of the character's damage, and when it dies, it poisons all enemies.

blade-dance.name: Blade Dance
blade-dance.description: In the Night Dancer's dance, every blade lands where an enemy stood a moment before.
blade-dance.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}: for the next {hits} enemy blows, dodge rises by {dodge pp}. Each dodge brings a counter dealing {counter%} damage and a slash for {blades%} at a random enemy.

shadow-whirl.name: Shadow Whirl
shadow-whirl.description: The Dancer vanishes into a whirl of shadows and cuts everything caught in it.
shadow-whirl.effect: Shadow Whirl: {blows} blows of {power%} damage each at random enemies.

shattering-blow.name: Shattering Blow
shattering-blow.description: The Berserker does not go around armour, but straight through it. After a blow like this, the enemy stays down for a long time.
shattering-blow.effect: A blow dealing {power%} damage that ignores {armorIgnore%} of the target's armour. The target may lose its next {stunMoves} turns ({stunChance%} chance).

berserker-roar.name: Berserker's Roar
berserker-roar.description: The roar carries across the battlefield. The enemies step back, and the Berserker charges forward.
berserker-roar.effect: For {turns} of the character's turns, enemies deal {weaken%} less damage, and the character deals {damage%} more.

steel-whirl.name: Steel Whirl
steel-whirl.description: The Champion whirls their weapon so fast that the steel blurs into a single flash. No one within reach escapes unwounded.
steel-whirl.effect: Attacks every enemy for {power%} damage, without a miss. When the target is a single enemy, it deals {single%}. Those hit bleed for {dotTicks} of their turns, losing {dotPower%} of the blow's damage each turn.

duel.name: Duel
duel.description: The Champion points their weapon at the most dangerous enemy. The crowd falls silent, for it knows how this will end.
duel.effect: Challenges the enemy with the most HP. Until the end of the fight, the character deals {damage%} more damage to it and takes {guard%} less from it.

unbending.name: Unbending
unbending.description: The Bastion will not bend under any blow. Wounds close, and the attacker gets back what they dealt.
unbending.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, recovers {heal%} of max HP and gains {armor%} more armour for {turns} of their own turns. Meanwhile, reflects {reflect%} of the damage taken.

shield-wall.name: Shield Wall
shield-wall.description: The Bastion drives the shield into the ground, and the party stands behind it shoulder to shoulder.
shield-wall.effect: For {turns} of the character's turns, the whole party has {wall%} more armour, and the character deals {damage%} more damage.

heart-shot.name: Heart Shot
heart-shot.description: The arrowhead seeks the heart and does not stop at the first one. The Sharpshooter counts hits in threes.
heart-shot.effect: A shot dealing {power%} damage that cannot be dodged, with the chance of a critical hit higher by {critBonus pp}. It pierces the target and hits {pierces} more enemies behind it, each for {pierce%} damage.

target-lock.name: Target Lock
target-lock.description: The Sharpshooter takes aim at an enemy. From that moment on, it has nowhere to hide.
target-lock.effect: Marks an enemy until it falls. The marked enemy takes {damage%} more damage from the character and cannot dodge it.

sky-thunder.name: Thunder from the Sky
sky-thunder.description: Arrows fall together with lightning. Whoever survives this rain will not have the use of their legs for a long while.
sky-thunder.effect: A rain of arrows and lightning deals {power%} lightning damage to all enemies. When the target is a single enemy, {single%}. Every enemy hit may lose its next turn ({stunChance%} chance).

thunder-orb.name: Thunder Orb
thunder-orb.description: A ball of lightning circles above the Thunder Lord's head. Again and again it strikes at the enemy.
thunder-orb.effect: Summons a thunder orb for {turns} of their own turns. Every turn the orb strikes a random enemy for {power%} lightning damage.

harpoon.name: Harpoon
harpoon.description: A heavy barbed head on a line. The quarry it hits will not break free.
harpoon.effect: A shot dealing {power%} damage. The enemy hit loses its next turn and bleeds for {dotTicks} of its turns, losing {dotPower%} of the shot's damage each turn.

wolf-call.name: Wolf
wolf-call.description: At the Huntmaster's whistle a wolf bursts out of the thicket. It stands by the hunter and never leaves their side.
wolf-call.effect: Summons a wolf for {turns} of their own turns. The wolf stands before the character with {hp%} of the character's max HP and takes the enemies' blows. Every turn it bites a random enemy for {power%} damage.

meteor-shower.name: Meteor Shower
meteor-shower.description: The sky cracks open and burning boulders fall from it. The fire does not choose whom it reaches.
meteor-shower.effect: A fire spell on all enemies deals {power%} damage, {single%} against a single target. Every enemy hit may catch Burn ({dotChance%} chance): for {dotTicks} of its turns it loses {dotPower%} of the spell's damage each turn.

elemental-harmony.name: Elemental Harmony
elemental-harmony.description: The Archmage weaves the elements into a single song. Each of them lends strength to the next.
elemental-harmony.effect: At the start of a fight, until its end: every element the character uses in spells during this fight makes their next spells {bonus%} stronger.

ice-star.name: Ice Star
ice-star.description: Ice gathers into a star with sharp points. Whoever already shivers with cold shatters beneath it like glass.
ice-star.effect: The ice star hits one enemy for {power%} frost damage. A chilled target takes {chilledBonus%} more.

ice-armor.name: Ice Armour
ice-armor.description: The Winter Lord wraps up in ice. Whoever strikes it feels their hands go numb.
ice-armor.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, turns {pool%} of max mana into ice armour that stops damage equal to {ratio%} of the mana taken. Whoever strikes the armour is slowed by {slow%}.

ent-summon.name: Summon Ent
ent-summon.description: A tree-being with bark as hard as stone grows out of the ground. It draws the blows to itself and strikes back with its branches.
ent-summon.effect: Summons an ent for {turns} of their own turns. The ent stands before the character with {hp%} of the character's max HP and takes the enemies' blows. Every turn it lashes a random enemy with its branches for {power%} damage.

bear-summon.name: Summon Bear
bear-summon.description: A bear steps out of the thicket and stands between the Druid and the enemies. Whoever comes closer will feel its claws.
bear-summon.effect: Summons a bear for {turns} of their own turns. The bear stands before the character with {hp%} of the character's max HP and takes the enemies' blows. Every turn it rakes a random enemy with its claws for {power%} damage.

great-renewal.name: Great Renewal
great-renewal.description: The Miracle Worker's prayer raises the whole party from its knees. Wounds keep healing long after it.
great-renewal.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, heals the whole party by {heal%.1} of max HP, plus 1 HP for every {wisdomPerHp} points of Wisdom. Then, for {hotTurns} of their own turns, heals everyone by {hot%} of max HP each turn.

life-aura.name: Aura of Life
life-aura.description: A warm light hovers around the Miracle Worker. Whoever stands in it regains strength with every breath.
life-aura.effect: When someone in the party has less than {below%} HP: for {turns} of the character's turns, the whole party recovers {heal%} of max HP every turn.

final-verdict.name: Final Verdict
final-verdict.description: The verdict falls before the enemy does. Holy fire finishes what steel began.
final-verdict.effect: A sacred verdict dealing {power%} damage to an enemy with less than {below%} HP left.

pyre.name: Pyre
pyre.description: Holy fire kindles beneath the Grand Inquisitor's enemies. It burns for as long as the Inquisitor wills it.
pyre.effect: For {turns} of the character's turns, holy fire burns the enemies: on each of the character's turns, every enemy takes {power%} sacred damage.

choir.name: Choir
choir.description: Voices no one can see join the High Priest's song. Wounds close, and arms grow strong.
choir.effect: For {turns} of the character's turns, the whole party recovers {heal%} of max HP every turn and deals {chorus%} more damage.

divine-shield.name: Divine Protection
divine-shield.description: A golden dome spreads over the party. The enemies' blows glance off it as off a rock.
divine-shield.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, the whole party gets a shield that stops damage equal to {guard%} of each one's max HP.

beheading.name: Beheading
beheading.description: The Kingslayer leaves no wounded. One cut, and the matter is closed.
beheading.effect: A blow dealing {power%} damage, always critical ({critPower%} in all), at the enemy standing furthest back. A target with less than {executeBelow%} HP takes {executeBonus%} more.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.description: The Kingslayer melts into the shadows. When they reappear, the blow falls where no one expects it.
vanish.effect: The character vanishes for one turn: enemies cannot hit them, and their next blow is critical and deals {power%} more damage.

raise-dead.name: Raise Dead
raise-dead.description: A skeleton warrior rises from the ground. Its sword is coated in green venom.
raise-dead.effect: A skeleton warrior rises for {turns} of the character's turns. It stands before the character with {hp%} of the character's max HP and takes the enemies' blows. Every turn it strikes a random enemy for {power%} damage and poisons it: for {dotTicks} turns the target loses {dotPower%} of the blow's damage each turn.

curse-of-decay.name: Curse of Decay
curse-of-decay.description: The Necromancer whispers words that wither the grass. Enemies rot while still alive, and their armour crumbles.
curse-of-decay.effect: The curse falls on all enemies: for {dotTicks} of their turns, each loses {dotPower%} of the character's blow damage each turn (Poison), and its armour weakens by {decay%} every turn.

blade-storm.name: Blade Storm
blade-storm.description: The Phantom turns into a whirl of blades. Blows fall faster than the enemy can count them.
blade-storm.effect: Blade Storm: {blows} blows of {power%} damage each at random enemies.

shadow-double.name: Shadow Double
shadow-double.description: The Phantom's shadow peels off the ground and stands at its side. It repeats every move like a reflection in black water.
shadow-double.effect: Summons the character's shadow for {turns} of their own turns. The shadow repeats each of the character's blows on the same target for {power%} damage.

smashing-blow.name: Smashing Blow
smashing-blow.description: The Horde Slayer's blow smashes armour and bone. Whoever stands behind the target gets hit with it.
smashing-blow.effect: A blow dealing {power%} damage that ignores {armorIgnore%} of the target's armour. The target may lose its next {stunMoves} turns ({stunChance%} chance). It also hits the enemy standing behind the target, for {pierce%} damage.

slaughter.name: Slaughter
slaughter.description: The Horde Slayer charges into the middle of the horde. The deeper the wounds, the more terrible the blows.
slaughter.effect: A blow at every enemy for {power%} damage, and at a single enemy for {single%}. The less HP the character has, the harder it hits: up to {rage%} more at {rageAt%} HP.

steel-hurricane.name: Steel Hurricane
steel-hurricane.description: The Legend spins twice before the enemy can blink. Steel cuts everything around.
steel-hurricane.effect: Two spins in one turn: each attacks every enemy for {power%} damage, without a miss, and a single enemy for {single%}. Those hit bleed for {dotTicks} of their turns, losing {dotPower%} of the blow's damage each turn.

cheers.name: Cheers
cheers.description: The stands go wild. With every enemy that falls, the roar of the crowd lifts the party higher.
cheers.effect: For {turns} of their own turns the whole party deals {chorus%} more damage, and {perKill%} more again for every enemy defeated.

unbroken.name: Unbroken
unbroken.description: The Colossus takes blows that would bring down a wall. Wounds close, and the attacker falls by their own strength.
unbroken.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, recovers {heal%} of max HP and gains {armor%} more armour for {turns} of their own turns. Meanwhile, reflects {reflect%} of the damage taken.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.description: The Colossus strikes the ground with the shield. The earth cracks, and the front rank of enemies is knocked off its feet.
earthquake.effect: A shield blow to the ground deals {power%} damage to every enemy, without a miss, and {single%} to a single enemy. Every enemy in front may lose its next turn ({stunChance%} chance).

master-shot.name: Master Shot
master-shot.description: The Bowmaster draws the string to the ear. The arrowhead passes through the whole enemy line.
master-shot.effect: A shot dealing {power%} damage that cannot be dodged, with the chance of a critical hit higher by {critBonus pp}. It pierces the target and hits every enemy in the rows behind it, each for {pierce%} damage.

steady-hand.name: Steady Hand
steady-hand.description: Breath slows, the world goes quiet. For a moment every arrow flies exactly where the Bowmaster wants.
steady-hand.effect: For {turns} of their own turns no enemy can dodge the character's shots, and their chance of a critical hit rises by {critBonus pp}.

perun-wrath.name: Perun's Wrath
perun-wrath.description: The sky turns black, and Perun hurls lightning by the handful. Each bolt seeks the next target.
perun-wrath.effect: Lightning deals {power%} lightning damage to all enemies, and {single%} to a single enemy. Every enemy hit may lose its next turn ({stunChance%} chance), and every bolt may jump to another enemy for {chainPower%} damage ({chainChance%} chance).

thunder-sign.name: Thunder Sign
thunder-sign.description: The Chosen traces in the air the thunder sign that was once carved above cottage doors to ward off lightning.
thunder-sign.effect: For {turns} of their own turns every blow of the party has a {chance%} chance to strike the enemy with lightning for {power%} of the blow's damage.

pack-leader.name: Pack Leader
pack-leader.description: A white alpha wolf, the leader of the pack, comes at the call. When it howls, the whole party charges into battle.
pack-leader.effect: Summons a white alpha wolf for {turns} of their own turns. The wolf stands before the character with {hp%} of the character's max HP and takes the enemies' blows. Every turn it bites a random enemy for {power%} damage, and while it stands, its howl gives the whole party {howl%} more damage.

eagle-talon.name: Eagle's Talon
eagle-talon.description: An eagle drops from the sky straight onto the weakest. Its talons strike at the eyes.
eagle-talon.effect: The eagle drops on the enemy with the fewest HP and deals {power%} damage. Blinded, it misses {blind%} of its blows for {blindTurns} of its turns.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.description: The sky tears open with fire, ice and lightning at once. The ground beneath the enemies burns, freezes and sparks.
cataclysm.effect: Fire, ice and lightning fall at once on all enemies for {power%} damage, and on a single enemy for {single%}, split equally between fire, frost and lightning. Every enemy hit may catch Burn ({dotChance%} chance: for {dotTicks} of its turns it loses {dotPower%} of the spell's damage each turn), is chilled, so it deals {chillWeaken%} less damage, and may lose its next turn ({stunChance%} chance).

elemental-shield.name: Elemental Shield
elemental-shield.description: Fire, ice and lightning circle the Avatar. Whoever reaches for the Avatar will feel one of them.
elemental-shield.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, turns {pool%} of max mana into an elemental shield that stops damage equal to {ratio%} of the mana taken. Whoever strikes it burns (Burn: for {burnTicks} turns it loses {burn%} of the character's blow damage each turn), slows down by {frost%} or may lose its next turn ({shock%} chance).

ice-storm.name: Ice Storm
ice-storm.description: Ice stars fall from the sky one after another. Whoever already shivers with cold shatters first.
ice-storm.effect: Ice falls on all enemies for {power%} frost damage, and on a single enemy for {single%}, and chills those hit, so they slow down by {slow%}. A chilled target takes {chilledBonus%} more.

ice-tomb.name: Ice Tomb
ice-tomb.description: Ice locks the enemy in a clear coffin. All you can hear is the ice cracking under the blows.
ice-tomb.effect: Locks the enemy with the most HP in ice and deals it {power%} frost damage. For {stunMoves} turns, frozen, it does not strike and takes {bonus%} more damage.

oak-awakening.name: Awakening of the Oak
oak-awakening.description: The ground trembles and an ancient oak rises from it. Its roots seize anyone who comes close.
oak-awakening.effect: Summons an ancient oak for {turns} of their own turns. The oak stands before the character with {hp%} of the character's max HP and takes the enemies' blows. Every turn it lashes a random enemy with its branches for {power%} damage and entangles it in roots: the enemy hit slows down by {root%}.

bison-call.name: Summon Bison
bison-call.description: A bison bursts out of the wilds, heavy as a boulder. First it rams, then it stands like a wall before the Archdruid.
bison-call.effect: Summons a bison for {turns} of their own turns. The bison charges the enemy in front for {charge%} damage and stuns it for its next turn, then stands before the character with {hp%} of the character's max HP and takes the enemies' blows. Every turn it gores a random enemy for {power%} damage.

miraculous-healing.name: Miraculous Healing
miraculous-healing.description: The Saint raises their hands, and the party rises from its knees stronger than before the fight.
miraculous-healing.effect: Once per fight, when HP falls below {below%}, heals the whole party by {heal%.1} of max HP, plus 1 HP for every {wisdomPerHp} points of Wisdom, and removes harmful effects from it. Then, for {hotTurns} of their own turns, heals everyone by {hot%} of max HP each turn.

holy-light.name: Holy Light
holy-light.description: A glow brighter than the sun shines from the Saint. It burns the enemies and gives the party strength.
holy-light.effect: The glow wounds all enemies for {power%} sacred damage, and a single enemy for {single%}. The whole party recovers {partyHeal%} of max HP each.

last-judgment.name: Last Judgment
last-judgment.description: Every sinner awaits the day of judgment. The Demon Slayer brings it sooner.
last-judgment.effect: A sacred verdict dealing {power%} damage to an enemy with less than {below%} HP left. Spirits and demons take {familyBonus%} more.

holy-seal.name: Holy Seal
holy-seal.description: A sign burns on the enemy's forehead that no blood can wash away. From now on, none of its wounds will heal.
holy-seal.effect: Burns a sacred seal into an enemy for {power%} damage. Until the end of the fight the marked enemy takes {damage%} more damage and cannot heal.

hymn.name: Hymn
hymn.description: The Prophet's song carries far beyond the battlefield. The party hears victory in it.
hymn.effect: For {turns} of the character's turns, the whole party recovers {heal%} of max HP every turn and deals {chorus%} more damage.

vision.name: Vision
vision.description: The Prophet sees every blow before it falls and warns the party before the enemy raises a weapon.
vision.effect: For {turns} of their own turns the whole party dodges blows {evasion pp} more often.

final-blow.name: Deathblow
final-blow.description: The Godslayer leaves no wounded. Whoever is already staggering will not get up after this blow.
final-blow.effect: A blow dealing {power%} damage, always critical ({critPower%} in all). Kills an enemy with less than {killBelow%} HP at once (except champions) and seeks such an enemy first; otherwise strikes the enemy standing furthest back. A target with less than {executeBelow%} HP takes {executeBonus%} more.

blood-mark.name: Blood Mark
blood-mark.description: The Godslayer marks the prey with a single cut. Blood flows, and every following blade strikes truer.
blood-mark.effect: A cut dealing {power%} damage marks the enemy: for {dotTicks} of its turns it bleeds, losing {dotPower%} of the blow's damage each turn, and until the end of the fight critical hits land on it {critMark pp} more often.

army-of-dead.name: Army of the Dead
army-of-dead.description: A skeleton knight in rusted armour rises from the ground. Its sword drips with green venom.
army-of-dead.effect: A skeleton knight rises for {turns} of the character's turns. It stands before the character with {hp%} of the character's max HP and takes the enemies' blows. Every turn it strikes a random enemy for {power%} damage and poisons it: for {dotTicks} turns the target loses {dotPower%} of the blow's damage each turn.

death-touch.name: Touch of Death
death-touch.description: The Lich touches the enemy with a bony hand. Life flows out of the enemy straight into the Lich.
death-touch.effect: A touch dealing {power%} poison damage poisons the enemy: for {dotTicks} of its turns it loses {dotPower%} of the blow's damage each turn. The character heals by {drain%} of the damage dealt.

shadow-storm.name: Shadow Storm
shadow-storm.description: Shadows tear off the ground and cut together with the Shadow Lord. There are more blows than the enemy can see.
shadow-storm.effect: Shadow Storm: {blows} blows of {power%} damage, each at a random enemy.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.description: The Shadow Lord puts out the sun over the battlefield. In the dark, the enemies strike blindly.
eclipse.effect: For {turns} of their own turns every enemy blow has a {eclipse%} chance to miss.

texts.title: Class evolution
texts.intro: At class level {level}, your character stands on the threshold of evolution. Choose one of the two paths. The other path will vanish for good. But do not worry – you will be able to redistribute the points invested in it once, on the evolved Skills.
texts.introFemale: At class level {level}, your character stands on the threshold of evolution. Choose one of the two paths. The other path will vanish for good. But do not worry – you will be able to redistribute the points invested in it once, on the evolved Skills.
texts.notReady: Before the evolution, choose a side path and spend your Skill Points.
texts.confirm: The evolution is for good. Only a resident of the Settlement will be able to change it. Choose {name}?
texts.ceremonyLine: Your new class is: {name}. Spend your Skill Points on your new abilities.
texts.spend: Spend your Skill Points on your new abilities.
texts.busy: The character is on an exploration. You can choose the evolution after it returns.
texts.resetText: A new class may need different stats. A reset puts every point spent back in the pool: from character levels and from class levels, spent by hand and with “Spend by class”.
texts.resetPool: Points to spend anew: {points} ({character} from character levels, {class} from class levels).
texts.resetPoolBonus: Points to spend anew: {points} ({character} from character levels, {class} from class levels, {bonus} from events).
texts.resetWarning: This reset is free, once. Decide now: you will not get this choice later.
texts.resetDone: The points are back in the pool. Spend them in the Stats tab.
texts.testText: Test version only: choose an evolution at any class level, with the option to undo it.
texts.undone: Evolution undone. The class, skills and stats are as they were before it.
texts.testLevelDone: The character is at class level {level}. Evolution waits in the Character tab.
texts.nextIntro: At class level {level}, your character stands on the threshold of the next evolution. From here this path leads only one way. Both skills will give way to new ones, and you will be able to spend the points invested in them anew.
texts.nextIntroFemale: At class level {level}, your character stands on the threshold of the next evolution. From here this path leads only one way. Both skills will give way to new ones, and you will be able to spend the points invested in them anew.
texts.nextWaiting: The next evolution awaits at class level {level}.
texts.nextNotReady: Before the next evolution, spend all your Skill Points.
texts.nextConfirm: The evolution is for good. Both skills will give way to new ones, and their points will come back to be spent. Accept {name}?
texts.testNext: Test version only: the next evolution at any class level, with the option to undo it.
texts.testDone: The character has already been through every evolution: {name}.
